newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa due unchanged, move down possible.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa due unchanged, move down possible.

text.p: Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA40
Cocoa would be more likely to go down than up, analysts said. Traders called it to open unchanged or one stg higher.
The most obvious support is at 1,000 stg, Elli Gifford, an independent technical analyst, said. But that level should hold, she said. There was nearby support at 1,015-1,020.
On the upside it would face trouble from 1,040 on upwards, she said. But there was more imposing resistance at 1,063.
London took the brunt of the strength in Sterling on Monday, broker GNI said. "Activity was pretty quiet, and there was no significant selling volume despite a negative chart picture," it said.
New York cocoa futures ended mostly a touch higher in light trading on Monday, buoyed by local short-covering.

Ivorian cocoa processing factories took delivery of around 122,000 tonnes of cocoa up to the end of June compared to 114,800 in the same period in 1995/96, port sources said on Monday. --Christopher Lyddon, London newsroom +44 171 542 7928
